name: Dawit II
contribution: Emperor of Ethiopia from 1508 to 1540, whose political center and palace was in Shewa.

checks.lead: Dawit II (Ge'ez: ዳዊት; c. 1496 – 2 September 1540), better known by his birth name of Lebna Dengel, and also known by the macaronic name Wanag Segad, was Emperor of Ethiopia from 1508 to 1540, whose political center and palace was in Shewa.
